_why: 0.16 mm layers to match the layer counts in the script (sieve floor and stencil 6 layers, spring band 4). 3 wall loops so the 1.8 mm tube is pure perimeters. Every part prints as used or upside down with 45 degree undersides only: no supports. The cup is 100 mm tall on a 60 mm floor, so it needs no brim. 15% infill. PETG for the spring, cup and lid; food-safe PETG or PLA for the rest.
